name: Gakuen Ojou-sama Kitan
source:
Sae Mikado is a genius girl who is good at everything since she were born, but she also have a supernatural ability she will put in use in her new academic life. 

[Shortly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1483]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
御门沙绘是一名天才少女，从出生起便无论做什么都得心应手。她还拥有一种超自然能力，并将在新的学园生活中运用这份力量。

[根据[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1483]Getchu.com[/url]简译]
